span.p:
own = operand[3:0]
in = own[1], push = own[0], field = own[3:2]
in_pin = own[3:2], bit = own[3:1], level = own[0]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center; width: 440px;

span.p:
control
cycles = 1 + delay (REPEAT: 1)
halted = pc ≥ program_words
issue = !halted & counter == 0
stall = issue & (FIFO & (push ? rx_full : tx_empty)
| ACC_PUSH & rx_full
| WAIT & gpio_in[in_pin] != level)
last = issue ? delay == 0 | REPEAT : counter == 1
skip = SKIP & in_shift_reg[bit] == level
| SKIP_RUN & newest n all level | SKIP_NORUN & !(newest n all level)
rc_next = rc == 0 ? delay : rc − 1
counter reg, 5 bits, rst → 0
issue & !stall → REPEAT ? 0 : delay
counter > 0 → counter − 1
rc reg, 5 bits, rst → 0
pc_en & REPEAT → rc_next

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pc_skip = skip
(pc + 1 + pc_skip: over the next word)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pc_back = REPEAT & rc_next != 0
(pc − operand: back to the body's label)

span.p:
gpio_en = issue & !stall & side & !JMP & !REPEAT
(one pin-write port: SET and every side effect)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
acc_en = issue & !stall
(the ACC kind picks acc's or poly's update)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
cfg_en = issue & CONFIG
(field 0 = shift_dir, 1 = open_drain[1:0], 2 = open_drain[3:2])
